definitions: measure word for cups of a drink
January (no sandhi: reading a number as a date/label keeps its original tone)
sorry, excuse me (casual; no sandhi here since hao3 isn't 4th tone)
who, whom (spoken register; read shuéi in formal/written register)
to see, to meet (also used as an informal goodbye)
1st, first (ordinal numbers also skip tone sandhi)
to study/work at a fixed time and place
one (used reading digits individually, e.g. phone numbers)
to come out of, to exit
sorry (formal; no sandhi since qi3 isn't 4th tone either)
too, so (used in the tai4...le pattern)
very good, fine (reply to 'how are you')
particle marking completion or change of state
not (used with 有 to negate possession)
